metrics.note: the two dashboards don't match and the founder can't tell which is real

hint: REAL STORY: Meta claims 3.9 ROAS (modelled conversions, 7-day-click) while Shopify last-click shows 2.0 — both are biased and the truth sits between. The founder is refereeing two dashboards that will never agree. LEVER: stop trusting platform ROAS as absolute; anchor on BLENDED CAC (total spend ÷ actual new customers from Shopify) and manage to that.
